hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

unfmt=$(gofmt -l . 2>/dev/null | head -5); dirty=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); msg=""; [ -n "$unfmt" ] && msg="gofmt 未通过: $(printf '%s' "$unfmt" | tr '\n' ' ')"; [ "$dirty" != "0" ] && msg="${msg:+$msg | }未提交改动 ${dirty} 项"; if [ -n "$msg" ]; then jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{systemMessage:$m}'; fi
